title: AC1021 TABLE row text-style handle-role matrix
scope: Verify all three ODA-defined TABLE-level row text-style hard-pointer slots, malformed-role fallback, and corrected same-object retry using generated AC1021 vectors.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
fields: Title row text-style handle: H group 7 hard pointer when table override bit 0x20000 is set.
Header row text-style handle: H group 7 hard pointer when table override bit 0x40000 is set.
Data row text-style handle: H group 7 hard pointer when table override bit 0x80000 is set.

generatedControls: For each individual title/header/data style slot, a soft-pointer encoding leaves the base TABLE readable but withholds that style handle and marks TABLE semantics incomplete.
The same DRW_Table parser instance then accepts the corrected hard-pointer encoding, retains the slot-specific handle, reports complete semantics, and reaches the expected trailing body sentinel.
implementation.result: Build succeeded; 1 of 1 focused tests passed.
